newsitem.title: USA: Network Equipment sees lower Q4 revs.
newsitem.headline: Network Equipment sees lower Q4 revs.

text.p: Network Equipment Technologies Inc Tuesday said it expects overall revenues for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ending in March to be below year-ago levels.

In a quarterly filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company also said it expects income from operations for the rest of fiscal 1997 to be below the comparable period of fiscal 1996.

The company, which provides multiservice backbone networks used by enterprises and global carriers, reported revenues of $91.8 million in the fourth quarter ended March 31, 1996 and $338.9 million for the fiscal year.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, the company said total revenues were down 3.6 percent.
The company attributed the decline in revenues to continued softness in the company's domestic channels and "other uncertainties."

Network Equipment reported operating income for the first nine months of fiscal 1997 of $22.7 million, down from $34.1 million for the year-ago period. For all of fiscal 1996, the company reported operating income of $47.4 million.
The company said it expects research and development spending, sales and marketing expenses and operating expenses to rise during the remainder of fiscal 1997.
